552be560-91ff-558c-a3f1-59113cae57bd.name: Sizing|Allocated (GB)
552be560-91ff-558c-a3f1-59113cae57bd.description: Sum of configured memory across the cluster's VMs. The one base figure with no native cluster metric. Note: powered-off VMs and templates still report configured memory, so treat this as an upper bound on what is really running.

ffe8d4b5-eb3a-5899-9d30-c3f17e06fea5.name: Sizing|Tierable of Used (GB)
ffe8d4b5-eb3a-5899-9d30-c3f17e06fea5.formula: ((sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|consumed_average, depth=1}) - sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|active_average, depth=1})) / 2) / 1048576
ffe8d4b5-eb3a-5899-9d30-c3f17e06fea5.description: Cold memory currently backed in DRAM, halved for conservatism. Consumed minus active, in that order -- active is the working set within consumed.

17140d43-d897-5731-9c5e-03b6e0afb381.name: Sizing|Active of Allocated (%)
17140d43-d897-5731-9c5e-03b6e0afb381.formula: (sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|active_average, depth=1}) / sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=VirtualMachine, metric=mem|guest_provisioned, depth=2})) * 100
17140d43-d897-5731-9c5e-03b6e0afb381.description: Raw active as a share of allocated, with NO headroom factor applied, so the number means what its name says. Apply headroom in the classification, not here.

ba1a8cf7-0168-51e1-afbf-e8fcc6af5eb1.name: Sizing|Active of Consumed (%)
ba1a8cf7-0168-51e1-afbf-e8fcc6af5eb1.formula: (sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|active_average, depth=1}) / sum(${adaptertype=VMWARE, objecttype=HostSystem, metric=mem|consumed_average, depth=1})) * 100
ba1a8cf7-0168-51e1-afbf-e8fcc6af5eb1.description: Plausibility check on the whole exercise. Typical estates sit at 8-12%, nearer 15% where databases dominate. Outside 5-20% suspect the metric, not the workload.

c25ea9ee-44d4-55cf-bed3-8a991542d205.name: Sizing|TEST Fleet Active depth3 (GB)
c25ea9ee-44d4-55cf-bed3-8a991542d205.description: A/B TEST ONLY. Measured tree depth from vSphere World to HostSystem is 3.

32111908-6660-5ffe-8d42-1f3ef17b74f8.name: Sizing|TEST Fleet Active depth10 (GB)
32111908-6660-5ffe-8d42-1f3ef17b74f8.description: A/B TEST ONLY. The inherited content uses depth=10. If this one reports data and depth3 does not, depth means 'up to N'; if the reverse, it means 'exactly N'.
